method.execution: No application, database, model, build, installation or tests executed.
method.importExtraction: Literal ESM import/re-export inventory paired with manual source review. Application entry execution is an explicit extension boundary.
method.scope: Independent Node Host/runtime/UI/Skills/SDK; separately installed app internals and legacy desktop are excluded.

dependencyBoundary.interpretation: Host holds platform conversation/grant/install/version registry state; SDK holds platform schema/packaging/transport contracts; SkillsLibrary is a dedicated Skills owner. No global shared module holds Assets/Scanning logic. Installed app code is outside this static core closure.

dataOwnership.content: Projects, conversations/messages, runtime settings/metrics, app manifest/install/version/data-pointer/grant registry, selected Skill fingerprints/disclosure. No application business records or copied Skill resource BLOBs.
Package provenance/digest/install revision, entries/enabled generations, full resource bytes/hashes/types. No project/conversation/Assets/Scanning tables.

dataOwnership.connection: Private app worker; core does not import app DB schema
dataOwnership.tables: Not defined by Host/SDK; manifest lifecycle owns schemaVersion/migration.
dataOwnership.content: App business data retained on uninstall. Upgrades stage copied private data and switch Host registry pointers.

crossOwnerContracts.contract: Lazy ensureSkills constructs a separate library + ConversationSkills adapter. Library mutations call skillsChanged and invalidate affected current runs.

validateQuick reads selected skill_entries/skill_packages metadata via library.db. This explicit narrow schema coupling avoids repeated BLOB reads during streaming; full validate uses actual resource fingerprints. No app business tables are queried.
Manifest validation and separate child stdio describe/lifecycle/tool dispatch. Core does not import app entry code. Project/recipient grants are independent of Skills.
Explicit runtime selection; project workspace cwd and scoped MCP endpoint are passed to ACP stdio runtime. Intelligence stays in runtime.

knownLegacyFallback.scope: Build-time declarative Skills resource bytes only; no Rust/native/desktop/source/schema import.
Built Host resolves first copied path; source checkout uses the resource fallback. No legacy app DB is opened.
settings() reports legacy-desktop/availableHere:false; no desktop provider settings are read.
legacy labels an earlier Host app private-data layout, not the desktop Assets/Scanning database.

runtimeRequirements: Installed/authenticated Grok CLI only when grok-acp is explicitly chosen; CLI/model/auth are not bundled.
Independent ESM closure needs no root node_modules or native Tauri binary.
buildContract.interpretation: Only compares existing artifact bytes; no build execution claimed. Source-current means all declared copied files match checked source/metadata/resources/UI.

bundledSkillsResource.execution: Declarative resource bytes only; script resources are inert and install no tools/permissions.

limitations: Static source/schema/hash inspection only; no runtime/provider validation claimed.
Installed applications may have business code/schema within their own package/private data, outside this core closure.
ConversationSkills explicitly depends on SkillLibrary generation/metadata schema; quick checks do not protect against arbitrary physical SQLite tampering.
Source checkout build still sources declarative Skills resources from src-tauri/resources; emitted runtime includes copied resources and needs no Rust/desktop source.
External ACP/Grok process authority is separate from app worker filesystem isolation.
